name: @supertokens-plugins/rownd-python
description: Rownd migration plugin for SuperTokens Python

scripts.build: if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv run python -m build; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then python -m pip install build && python -m build; else python3 -m pip install build && python3 -m build; fi
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run pyright
scripts.clean: rm -rf .turbo dist build src/*.egg-info .pytest_cache .ruff_cache src/supertokens_rownd/__pycache__ tests/__pycache__
